title: Lubricant R&D sample and label record
description: Batch-produced sample object. A sample is a physical portion of a batch that travels to a bench or lab, so it carries what the label printer needs (label.printed_text and label.printed_at), when it was prepared, how it is stored, and a chain of custody from preparation onward. The chain_of_custody list is non-empty and every handover names from, to, time, and purpose, because an untraceable sample cannot support a downstream measurement. status tracks the sample through PREPARED, IN_TRANSIT, CONSUMED, ARCHIVED, or VOID.

formula_reference.description: Formula and version this sample represents; recorded on the sample so a measurement stays bound to the formulation even if the batch record is revised.

label.description: What the label printer actually produced: the printed text and the printing time. printed_at accepts an ISO date or an ISO date-time.

printed_at.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) or ISO date-time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, optional fraction and zone).

storage.description: Storage condition and location for this sample (container, temperature, atmosphere).

chain_of_custody.description: Ordered handovers from preparation to the current holder. minItems 1: a sample with no recorded custody cannot be used as measurement evidence.

custody_entry.description: One handover of the sample. purpose states why the sample moved, so custody records why a measurement was possible at the receiving end.
